name: Mesa Pegasus
description: A winged horse that legend says appears to blessed brides in Sursi, granting long life and good fortune.

description_citations.work: Introductory Two-Player Set: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Introductory Two-Player Set: card flavor text (Introductory Two-Player Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Legend holds a Mesa Pegasus appears to a pure-hearted bride in Sursi, blessing her family.
timeline.quote: Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear
